availability_source: JustWatch US (apis.justwatch.com), subscription (flatrate) offers only. All rows re-verified 2026-10-30 (includes HIDIVE)

items.title: John Wick: Chapter 3 - Parabellum
items.why: You gave John Wick 10 and Chapter 2 a 9, so this is next in order: Wick on the run with a bounty on his head. Nonstop, inventive action.
items.synopsis: Super-assassin John Wick returns with a $14 million price tag on his head and an army of bounty-hunting killers on his trail. After killing a member of the shadowy international assassin’s guild, the High Table, John Wick is excommunicado, but the world’s most ruthless hit men and women await his every turn.

items.title: Die Hard: With a Vengeance
items.why: Next after Die Hard 2 (8.5): McClane and Samuel L. Jackson race around New York solving a bomber's riddles. Fast, funny, and propulsive.
items.synopsis: New York detective John McClane is back and kicking bad-guy butt in the third installment of this action-packed series, which finds him teaming with civilian Zeus Carver to prevent the loss of innocent lives. McClane thought he'd seen it all, until a genius named Simon engages McClane, his new "partner" -- and his beloved city -- in a deadly game that demands their concentration.

items.title: The Bourne Supremacy
items.why: Next after The Bourne Identity (7.5): Bourne is framed and hunted across Europe. Tighter and faster, with a great Moscow car chase.
items.synopsis: A CIA operation to purchase classified Russian documents is blown by a rival agent, who then shows up in the sleepy seaside village where Bourne and Marie have been living. The pair run for their lives and Bourne, who promised retaliation should anyone from his former life attempt contact, is forced to once again take up his life as a trained assassin to survive.

items.title: The Running Man
items.why: Edgar Wright's take on the deadly game show: a desperate man runs for his life on live TV. A high-concept chase thriller from 2025.
items.synopsis: Desperate to save his sick daughter, working-class Ben Richards is convinced by The Running Man's charming but ruthless producer to enter the deadly competition game as a last resort. But Ben's defiance, instincts, and grit turn him into an unexpected fan favorite — and a threat to the entire system. As ratings skyrocket, so does the danger, and Ben must outwit not just the Hunters, but a nation addicted to watching him fall.

items.title: Limitless
items.why: A struggling writer takes a pill that unlocks his full brain. A fast, clever high-concept thriller in the Lucy (9.5) lane.
items.synopsis: The life of an unsuccessful writer is transformed by a top-secret 'smart drug' that allows him to use 100% of his brain and become a perfect version of himself. His enhanced abilities soon attract shadowy forces that threaten his new life.

items.title: Dragon Ball Super: Broly
items.why: Explore pick: a Dragon Ball movie with a Saiyan who's stronger than Goku. Pure shonen-fight spectacle for a Bleach and Hunter x Hunter fan.
items.synopsis: Earth is peaceful following the Tournament of Power. Realizing that the universes still hold many more strong people yet to see, Goku spends all his days training to reach even greater heights. Then one day, Goku and Vegeta are faced by a Saiyan called 'Broly' who they've never seen before. The Saiyans were supposed to have been almost completely wiped out in the destruction of Planet Vegeta, so what's this one doing on Earth? This encounter between the three Saiyans who have followed completely different destinies turns into a stupendous battle, with even Frieza (back from Hell) getting caught up in the mix.

items.title: Apocalypto
items.why: A Mayan hunter escapes capture and runs for home through the jungle. A relentless chase film, with action in the 300 (8) vein.
items.synopsis: Set in the Mayan civilization, when a man's idyllic presence is brutally disrupted by a violent invading force, he is taken on a perilous journey to a world ruled by fear and oppression where a harrowing end awaits him. Through a twist of fate and spurred by the power of his love for his woman and his family he will make a desperate break to return home and to ultimately save his way of life.

items.title: Avatar
items.why: James Cameron's Pandora epic about a paralyzed Marine in an alien body. A huge, immersive sci-fi adventure that holds up on a big screen.
items.synopsis: In the 22nd century, a paraplegic Marine is dispatched to the moon Pandora on a unique mission, but becomes torn between following orders and protecting an alien civilization.

items.title: Pirates of the Caribbean: On Stranger Tides
items.why: The fourth Pirates: Jack Sparrow, Blackbeard, and the Fountain of Youth. You've seen 1, 2, 3 and 5, so this is the missing one.
items.synopsis: When Jack crosses paths with a woman from his past, he's not sure if it's love...or if she's a ruthless con artist using him to find the fabled Fountain of Youth.

items.title: Scream
items.why: The slasher that made everyone know the rules, and it's a whodunit as much as a horror. You gave it an 8, and this is the first entry in the series you haven't seen.
items.synopsis: A year after the murder of her mother, a teenage girl is terrorized by a masked killer who targets her and her friends by using scary movies as part of a deadly game.

items.title: The Fast and the Furious
items.why: Street racers, a heist crew, and an undercover cop. The first of a series you can watch in order, and plain, fast fun.
items.synopsis: Dominic Toretto is a Los Angeles street racer suspected of masterminding a series of big-rig hijackings. When undercover cop Brian O'Conner infiltrates Toretto's iconoclastic crew, he falls for Toretto's sister and must choose a side: the gang or the LAPD.

items.title: Red Notice
items.why: An FBI profiler, an art thief, and an even better thief race across the world for Cleopatra's eggs. A glossy, crowd-pleasing action comedy.
items.synopsis: An Interpol-issued Red Notice is a global alert to hunt and capture the world's most wanted. But when a daring heist brings together the FBI's top profiler and two rival criminals, there's no telling what will happen.

items.title: A Quiet Place: Day One
items.why: The day the sound-hunting creatures arrived, in New York. Creature horror that's tense and fast, and the earliest chapter of the series.
items.synopsis: A young woman named Sam finds herself trapped in New York City during the early stages of an invasion by alien creatures with ultra-sensitive hearing.

items.title: Elysium
items.why: Neill Blomkamp's rich-versus-poor sci-fi action, with Matt Damon in an exoskeleton. Same director as District 9 (8.8).
items.synopsis: In the year 2159, two classes of people exist: the very wealthy who live on a pristine man-made space station called Elysium, and the rest, who live on an overpopulated, ruined Earth. Secretary Rhodes, a hard line government official, will stop at nothing to enforce anti-immigration laws and preserve the luxurious lifestyle of the citizens of Elysium. That doesn’t stop the people of Earth from trying to get in, by any means they can. When unlucky Max is backed into a corner, he agrees to take on a daunting mission that, if successful, will not only save his life, but could bring equality to these polarized worlds.

items.title: Air
items.why: Explore pick: how Nike chased Michael Jordan in 1984. A quick, funny business drama with a great cast that plays like a heist.
items.synopsis: Discover the game-changing partnership between a then undiscovered Michael Jordan and Nike's fledgling basketball division which revolutionized the world of sports and culture with the Air Jordan brand.

items.title: Don't Breathe
items.why: Three burglars break into a blind veteran's house and it goes badly wrong. A tight, fast home-invasion thriller.
items.synopsis: A group of teens break into a blind man's home thinking they'll get away with the perfect crime. They're wrong.

items.title: The Hunger Games
items.why: A girl volunteers for a televised fight to the death. A propulsive dystopian action film, and the first of its series.
items.synopsis: In a dystopian society where the Capitol forces each district to send two young tributes to fight to the death in a televised spectacle, a girl volunteers to take her sister’s place, setting the stage for a struggle of survival and defiance.

items.title: Scarface
items.why: Al Pacino as a Cuban refugee who builds a Miami drug empire. A crime classic with big, quotable scenes, in the Casino and Pulp Fiction (9) vein.
items.synopsis: After getting a green card in exchange for assassinating a Cuban government official, Tony Montana stakes a claim on the drug trade in Miami. Viciously murdering anyone who stands in his way, Tony eventually becomes the biggest drug lord in the state, controlling nearly all the cocaine that comes through Miami. But increased pressure from the police, wars with Colombian drug cartels and his own drug-fueled paranoia serve to fuel the flames of his eventual downfall.

items.title: Now You See Me
items.why: A team of stage magicians pulls off heists live and the FBI can't catch them. A slick, twisty crowd-pleaser.
items.synopsis: An FBI agent and an Interpol detective track a team of illusionists who pull off bank heists during their performances and reward their audiences with the money.

items.title: X-Men
items.why: The first X-Men: mutants split between Professor X and Magneto. You've seen Apocalypse (8), and this is where the series starts.
items.synopsis: Two mutants, Rogue and Wolverine, come to a private academy for their kind whose resident superhero team, the X-Men, must oppose a terrorist organization with similar powers.

items.title: My Hero Academia: Two Heroes
items.why: Explore pick: the first My Hero Academia movie, with All Might and Deku on a floating island. Pure action for a fan who gave the series 9.7.
items.synopsis: All Might and Deku accept an invitation to go abroad to a floating and mobile manmade city, called 'I-Island', where they research quirks as well as hero supplemental items at the special 'I-Expo' convention that is currently being held on the island. During that time, suddenly, despite an iron wall of security surrounding the island, the system is breached by a villain, and the only ones able to stop him are the students of Class 1-A.

items.title: Crawl
items.why: A woman trapped in a flooded basement with giant alligators during a hurricane. Short, fast creature-feature action.
items.synopsis: When a huge hurricane hits her hometown in Florida, Haley ignores evacuation orders to look for her father. After finding him badly wounded, both are trapped by the flood. With virtually no time to escape the storm, they discover that rising water levels are the least of their problems.

items.title: Underwater
items.why: A crew at the bottom of the ocean floor wakes something. Fast sci-fi creature horror in the Alien and Prometheus (9) style.
items.synopsis: After an earthquake destroys their underwater station, six researchers must navigate two miles along the dangerous, unknown depths of the ocean floor to make it to safety in a race against time.

items.title: Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone
items.why: The first Harry Potter: a boy learns he's a wizard and goes to Hogwarts. Fantasy adventure to start in order.
items.synopsis: Harry Potter has lived under the stairs at his aunt and uncle's house his whole life. But on his 11th birthday, he learns he's a powerful wizard—with a place waiting for him at the Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry. As he learns to harness his newfound powers with the help of the school's kindly headmaster, Harry uncovers the truth about his parents' deaths—and about the villain who's to blame.

items.title: The Man from Nowhere
items.why: A quiet pawnbroker goes after the gang that took a little girl. Korean action-revenge with a John Wick feel.
items.synopsis: A reclusive pawnshop owner goes on a brutal rampage to rescue a young girl kidnapped by a criminal organization.

items.title: Orphan
items.why: A family adopts a 9-year-old girl who isn't what she seems. A creepy thriller with a twist most people don't see coming.
items.synopsis: After losing their baby, a married couple adopt 9-year old Esther, who may not be as innocent as she seems.

items.title: Straight Outta Compton
items.why: Explore pick: the rise of N.W.A. from Compton to the top of music. A fast, high-energy biopic.
items.synopsis: In 1987, five young men, using brutally honest rhymes and hardcore beats, put their frustration and anger about life in the most dangerous place in America into the most powerful weapon they had: their music.  Taking us back to where it all began, Straight Outta Compton tells the true story of how these cultural rebels—armed only with their lyrics, swagger, bravado and raw talent—stood up to the authorities that meant to keep them down and formed the world’s most dangerous group, N.W.A.  And as they spoke the truth that no one had before and exposed life in the hood, their voice ignited a social revolution that is still reverberating today.

items.title: 21 Jump Street
items.why: Two cops go undercover as high schoolers. Fast action comedy, and the first of its series.
items.synopsis: When cops Schmidt and Jenko join the secret Jump Street unit, they use their youthful appearances to go undercover as high school students. They trade in their guns and badges for backpacks, and set out to shut down a dangerous drug ring. But, as time goes on, Schmidt and Jenko discover that high school is nothing like it was just a few years earlier -- and, what's more, they must again confront the teenage terror and anxiety they thought they had left behind.

items.title: Life
items.why: Astronauts bring back a Martian organism and it grows. Claustrophobic creature sci-fi with a nasty ending.
items.synopsis: The six-member crew of the International Space Station is tasked with studying a sample from Mars that may be the first proof of extra-terrestrial life, which proves more intelligent than ever expected.

items.title: Enola Holmes 3
items.why: You rated Enola Holmes 8 and Enola Holmes 2 7.5, so this is next. Millie Bobby Brown's Sherlock's sister solves another case.
items.synopsis: Detective Enola Holmes heads to Malta, where her aspirations merge in her most complex and dangerous case yet.

items.title: Escape Plan
items.why: Stallone and Schwarzenegger break out of a prison built to be inescapable. A prison-break action thriller with all the old-school action swagger.
items.synopsis: Ray Breslin is the world's foremost authority on structural security. After analyzing every high security prison and learning a vast array of survival skills so he can design escape-proof prisons, his skills are put to the test. He's framed and incarcerated in a master prison he designed himself. He needs to escape and find the person who put him behind bars.

items.title: Icarus
items.why: Explore pick: a cyclist's doping experiment turns into a spy story about Russia's state-sponsored program. A true thriller, and it won the Oscar.
items.synopsis: While investigating the furtive world of illegal doping in sports, director Bryan Fogel connects with renegade Russian scientist Dr. Grigory Rodchenkov—a pillar of his country's "anti-doping" program. Over dozens of Skype calls, urine samples, and badly administered hormone injections, Fogel and Rodchenkov grow closer despite shocking allegations that place Rodchenkov at the center of Russia's state-sponsored Olympic doping program.

items.title: The Ritual
items.why: Friends take a shortcut through a Swedish forest and something hunts them. The creature reveal pays off.
items.synopsis: A group of university friends reunite for a hiking trip in Sweden, but are stalked by a menacing presence when they're diverted through the woods.

items.title: Lone Survivor
items.why: A four-man SEAL team is trapped in the Afghan mountains, based on a true story. A relentless, harrowing firefight.
items.synopsis: Four Navy SEALs on a covert mission to neutralize a high-level Taliban operative must make an impossible moral decision in the mountains of Afghanistan that leads them into an enemy ambush. As they confront unthinkable odds, the SEALs must find reserves of strength and resilience to fight to the finish.

items.title: The Godfather
items.why: The Corleone family saga, and the first in its series. A crime classic that you can watch in order.
items.synopsis: Spanning the years 1945 to 1955, a chronicle of the fictional Italian-American Corleone crime family. When organized crime family patriarch, Vito Corleone barely survives an attempt on his life, his youngest son, Michael steps in to take care of the would-be killers, launching a campaign of bloody revenge.

items.title: Fresh
items.why: A first date goes terribly wrong. A dark horror comedy with a great first act and a nasty twist.
items.synopsis: Frustrated by scrolling dating apps only to end up on lame, tedious dates, Noa takes a chance by giving her number to the awkwardly charming Steve after a produce-section meet-cute at the grocery store.

items.title: 8 Mile
items.why: Explore pick: Eminem's semi-autobiographical rap battle story in Detroit. A fast, gritty drama with a famous finale.
items.synopsis: For Jimmy Smith, Jr., life is a daily fight just to keep hope alive. Feeding his dreams in Detroit's vibrant music scene, Jimmy wages an extraordinary personal struggle to find his own voice - and earn a place in a world where rhymes rule, legends are born and every moment… is another chance.

items.title: American Sniper
items.why: Chris Kyle's four tours in Iraq. A tense, propulsive war drama directed by Clint Eastwood.
items.synopsis: U.S. Navy SEAL Chris Kyle takes his sole mission—protect his comrades—to heart and becomes one of the most lethal snipers in American history. His pinpoint accuracy not only saves countless lives but also makes him a prime target of insurgents. Despite grave danger and his struggle to be a good husband and father to his family back in the States, Kyle serves four tours of duty in Iraq. However, when he finally returns home, he finds that he cannot leave the war behind.

items.title: Safe
items.why: Jason Statham protects a young math genius from the Triads, the Russian mob and corrupt cops. Brisk, no-nonsense action.
items.synopsis: After a former elite agent rescues a 12-year-old Chinese girl who's been abducted, they find themselves in the middle of a standoff between Triads, the Russian Mafia and high-level corrupt New York City politicians and police.

items.title: Hustle
items.why: Explore pick: Adam Sandler as a scout who finds a street player in Spain and takes a shot at the NBA. A sports underdog story with some real heart and swagger.
items.synopsis: A basketball scout discovers a phenomenal street ball player while in Spain and sees the prospect as his opportunity to get back into the NBA.

items.title: Green Room
items.why: A punk band trapped in a neo-Nazi club after seeing a murder. A tight, vicious siege thriller.
items.synopsis: Members of a punk rock band and a tough young woman are forced to fight for survival after witnessing an act of violence at a skinhead bar.

items.title: Okja
items.why: Explore pick: a girl crosses the world to rescue her giant super-pig from a corporation. Bong Joon-ho's mix of creature adventure, satire, and chase.
items.synopsis: A young girl named Mija risks everything to prevent a powerful, multi-national company from kidnapping her best friend - a massive animal named Okja.

items.title: Dante's Peak
items.why: A volcanologist fights to evacuate a small town before the mountain erupts. Fun 90s disaster movie.
items.synopsis: Volcanologist Harry Dalton comes to the sleepy town of Dante's Peak to investigate the recent rumblings of the dormant volcano the burg is named for. Before long, his worst fears are realized when a massive eruption hits, and immediately, Harry, the mayor and the townspeople find themselves fighting for their lives amid a catastrophic nightmare.

items.title: They Live
items.why: A drifter finds sunglasses that reveal aliens running the world. John Carpenter's sci-fi action cult classic, with a famously long fight scene.
items.synopsis: A lone drifter stumbles upon a unique pair of sunglasses that reveal aliens are systematically gaining control of the Earth by masquerading as humans and lulling the public into submission.

items.title: Ip Man
items.why: The true story of the martial artist who taught Bruce Lee, during the Japanese occupation. Great fight scenes, and it's the first of its series.
items.synopsis: A semi-biographical account of Yip Man, the first martial arts master to teach the Chinese martial art of Wing Chun. The film focuses on events surrounding Ip that took place in the city of Foshan between the 1930s to 1940s during the Second Sino-Japanese War. Directed by Wilson Yip, the film stars Donnie Yen in the lead role, and features fight choreography by Sammo Hung.

items.title: The Sting
items.why: Explore pick: two con men run an elaborate scam on a mob boss. The Best Picture winner that set the template for heist movies.
items.synopsis: Two grifters team up to pull off the ultimate con.

items.title: Bodies Bodies Bodies
items.why: Rich friends at a hurricane party play a murder game and then someone really dies. A fast, nasty dark comedy whodunit.
items.synopsis: In an isolated family mansion, a group of rich 20-somethings decides to play Bodies Bodies Bodies, a game where one of them is secretly a "killer" while the rest tries to "escape". Things take a turn for the worse when real bodies start turning up, setting off a paranoid and dangerous chain of events.

items.title: Your Name.
items.why: Explore pick: two teens swap bodies across distance and time. A twisty, emotional anime hit, and the highest-grossing anime film for years.
items.synopsis: High schoolers Mitsuha and Taki are complete strangers living separate lives. But one night, they suddenly switch places. Mitsuha wakes up in Taki’s body, and he in hers. This bizarre occurrence continues to happen randomly, and the two must adjust their lives around each other.

items.title: Highlander
items.why: Immortal swordsmen fight through the centuries until only one remains. A cult fantasy-action classic with a great Queen soundtrack.
items.synopsis: He fought his first battle on the Scottish Highlands in 1536. He will fight his greatest battle on the streets of New York City in 1986. His name is Connor MacLeod. He is immortal.

items.title: Fire of Love
items.why: Explore pick: a documentary on two volcanologists who spent their lives chasing eruptions. Stunning footage, and it's more dangerous than most thrillers.
items.synopsis: Intrepid scientists and lovers Katia and Maurice Krafft died in a volcanic explosion doing the very thing that brought them together: unraveling the mysteries of volcanoes by capturing the most explosive imagery ever recorded.

items.title: The Haunting of Hill House
items.why: Mike Flanagan's family ghost story, with real scares and a structure that keeps revealing. You gave his Usher an 8.5 and Cabinet of Curiosities a 9.5. Complete in 10 episodes.
items.synopsis: Flashing between past and present, a fractured family confronts haunting memories of their old home and the terrifying events that drove them from it.

items.title: Hannibal
items.why: A crime procedural that's really a horror series, with a stunning cat-and-mouse. For your Se7en and Bates Motel (9) side.
items.synopsis: Explores the early relationship between renowned psychiatrist Hannibal Lecter and a young FBI criminal profiler who is haunted by his ability to empathize with serial killers.

items.title: Invincible
items.why: The Boys (10) as Western adult animation: brutal, funny, and long-arc.
items.synopsis: Mark Grayson is a normal teenager except for the fact that his father is the most powerful superhero on the planet. Shortly after his seventeenth birthday, Mark begins to develop powers of his own and enters into his father's tutelage.

items.title: From
items.why: Mystery-box horror: a town nobody can leave and monsters with rules. Lost meets Dark.
items.synopsis: Unravel the mystery of a nightmarish town in middle America that traps all those who enter. As the unwilling residents fight to keep a sense of normalcy and search for a way out, they must also survive the threats of the surrounding forest – including the terrifying creatures that come out when the sun goes down.

items.title: The Outsider
items.why: Stephen King: an impossible crime with the suspect in two places at once. Procedural that slides into supernatural.
items.synopsis: When an insidious supernatural force edges its way into a seemingly straightforward investigation into the gruesome murder of a young boy, it leads a seasoned cop and an unorthodox investigator to question everything they believe in.

items.title: Fringe
items.why: High-concept X-Files with parallel universes, built on a big mythology that pays off. It finishes on a real ending.
items.synopsis: An F.B.I. agent is forced to work with an institutionalized scientist and his son in order to rationalize a brewing storm of unexplained phenomena.

items.title: Primal
items.why: Genndy Tartakovsky's wordless caveman-and-dinosaur saga: savage, gorgeous, and surprisingly moving. Adult animation is your highest-rated lane, and this is one of its best.
items.synopsis: A caveman and a dinosaur bond over unfortunate tragedies and become each other's only hope of survival in a treacherous world.

items.title: Lovecraft Country
items.why: Cosmic horror, monsters, and pulp adventure in 1950s America, a new creature every episode. The pulpy horror-series lane where The Strain and Cabinet of Curiosities scored highest.
items.synopsis: The anthology horror series follows 25-year-old Atticus Freeman, who joins up with his friend Letitia and his Uncle George to embark on a road trip across 1950s Jim Crow America to find his missing father. They must survive and overcome both the racist terrors of white America and the malevolent spirits that could be ripped from a Lovecraft paperback.

items.title: Pantheon
items.why: Mind-upload sci-fi with Black Mirror and Altered Carbon stakes. Complete in 2 seasons.
items.synopsis: A bullied teen receives mysterious help from someone online: a stranger soon revealed to be her recently deceased father, David, whose consciousness has been uploaded to the Cloud following an experimental destructive brain scan. David is the first of a new kind of being – an “Uploaded Intelligence” or “UI” – but he will not be the last, as a global conspiracy unfolds that threatens to trigger a new kind of world war.

items.title: Alien: Earth
items.why: Noah Hawley's Alien series: hybrids, xenomorphs, and corporate war on Earth. For your Prometheus side.
items.synopsis: When the mysterious deep space research vessel USCSS Maginot crash-lands on Earth, Wendy and a ragtag group of tactical soldiers make a fateful discovery that puts them face-to-face with the planet's greatest threat.

items.title: Kingdom
items.why: A Joseon-era zombie political thriller: palace intrigue plus a plague. Two tight seasons.
items.synopsis: In this zombie thriller set in Korea's medieval Joseon dynasty which has been defeated by corruption and famine, a mysterious rumor of the king’s death spreads, as does a strange plague that renders the infected immune to death and hungry for flesh. The crown prince, fallen victim to a conspiracy, sets out on a journey to unveil the evil scheme and save his people.

items.title: The Expanse
items.why: Rule-consistent hard sci-fi with a big mystery. Complete in 6 seasons. S1 starts slow, then takes off.
items.synopsis: A thriller set two hundred years in the future following the case of a missing young woman who brings a hardened detective and a rogue ship's captain together in a race across the solar system to expose the greatest conspiracy in human history.

items.title: Gen V
items.why: Spin-off of The Boys: same tone, same universe, shorter seasons.
items.synopsis: At America's only college for superheroes, gifted students put their moral boundaries to the test, competing for the university's top ranking, and a chance to join The Seven, Vought International's elite superhero team. When the school's dark secrets come to light, they must decide what kind of heroes they want to become.

items.title: Peacemaker
items.why: James Gunn's irreverent superhero comedy (The Suicide Squad 9).
items.synopsis: The continuing story of Peacemaker, a vainglorious superhero/supervillain who believes in peace at any cost — no matter how many people he has to kill. After a miraculous recovery from his duel with Bloodsport, Peacemaker soon discovers that his freedom comes at a price.

items.title: Scavengers Reign
items.why: Stranded crew members try to survive on a beautiful, deeply hostile alien planet. Creature-feature sci-fi with Love, Death & Robots (10) ambition.
items.synopsis: When a deep space freighter is damaged by a solar flare its surviving crew are stranded on a beautiful and unforgiving planet. They begin to learn the true nature of this planet as they try to survive long enough to escape or be rescued.

items.title: Fargo
items.why: Crime anthology with dark comedy and escalating violence. Each season is self-contained, with an Ozark (11) vibe.
items.synopsis: A close-knit anthology series dealing with stories involving malice, violence and murder based in and around Minnesota.

items.title: The Penguin
items.why: Crime saga with a morally gray rise-to-power arc, like Ozark and Breaking Bad.
items.synopsis: Follow Oswald "Oz" Cobb’s quest for control as he seeks to fill the power vacuum left by the death of Carmine Falcone, transforming from a disfigured nobody to a noted mobster in Gotham City.

items.title: Marianne
items.why: French horror series: a novelist finds the witch she writes about is real and coming for her hometown. Considered one of Netflix's scariest; 8 episodes.
items.synopsis: When a novelist realizes her terrifying stories are coming true, she returns to her hometown to face the demons from her past that inspire her writing.

items.title: Legion
items.why: Trippy X-Men-adjacent show about a mutant who may be insane. Inventive and high-concept, with 3 seasons and a full ending.
items.synopsis: David Haller, AKA Legion, is a troubled young man who may be more than human. Diagnosed as schizophrenic, David has been in and out of psychiatric hospitals for years. But after a strange encounter with a fellow patient, he’s confronted with the possibility that the voices he hears and the visions he sees might be real.

items.title: The Leftovers
items.why: Two percent of the world vanishes and the people left behind fall apart. A slow first season that becomes one of TV's best; Lost and Dark (10) fans tend to love it.
items.synopsis: When 2% of the world's population abruptly disappears without explanation, the world struggles to understand just what they're supposed to do about it. This is the story of the people who didn't make the cut.

items.title: Castlevania: Nocturne
items.why: Follow-up to Castlevania (your 9). Dark fantasy action, set during the French Revolution.
items.synopsis: As revolution sweeps France, Richter Belmont fights to uphold his family's legacy and prevent the rise of a ruthless, power-hungry vampire ruler.

items.title: Parasyte: The Grey
items.why: Parasitic aliens take over human hosts in Korea, from the Train to Busan director. Six tight episodes of body horror action.
items.synopsis: When unidentified parasites violently take over human hosts and gain power, humanity must rise to combat the growing threat.

items.title: Travelers
items.why: Future operatives' minds are sent into people about to die, to stop a collapse. Time-travel rules with Dark-style consequences, complete in 3 seasons.
items.synopsis: Hundreds of years from now, the last surviving humans discover the means of sending consciousness back through time, directly into people in the 21st century. These "travelers" assume the lives of seemingly random people, while secretly working as teams to perform missions in order to save humanity from a terrible future.

items.title: True Detective
items.why: Season 1 is an occult-tinged serial-killer case told across two timelines. Standalone, so you can stop after it.
items.synopsis: An American anthology police detective series utilizing multiple timelines in which investigations seem to unearth personal and professional secrets of those involved, both within or outside the law.

items.title: Person of Interest
items.why: An AI predicts crimes and two men act on its numbers. It turns into a superintelligence war, and it ends well.
items.synopsis: John Reese, former CIA paramilitary operative, is presumed dead and teams up with reclusive billionaire Finch to prevent violent crimes in New York City by initiating their own type of justice. With the special training that Reese has had in Covert Operations and Finch's genius software inventing mind, the two are a perfect match for the job that they have to complete. With the help of surveillance equipment, they work "outside the law" and get the right criminal behind bars.

items.title: Cassandra
items.why: A German sci-fi horror miniseries: a family moves into a smart home whose 1970s AI won't let them go. Black Mirror (10) meets Dark (10).
items.synopsis: A family moves into a vintage smart home and discovers that it's under the control of a virtual assistant — who will stop at nothing to keep them there.

items.title: Blue Eye Samurai
items.why: A revenge epic in Edo Japan with stunning animation. Its action-and-plot balance is like Castlevania (9).
items.synopsis: In Edo-period Japan, a young warrior driven by a dream of revenge cuts a bloody path toward destiny.

items.title: Mindhunter
items.why: Two FBI agents interview imprisoned serial killers to invent criminal profiling. A crime show built on unnerving conversations, closer to Hannibal than to a procedural.
items.synopsis: An agent in the FBI's Elite Serial Crime Unit develops profiling techniques as he pursues notorious serial killers and rapists.

items.title: Band of Brothers
items.why: The definitive WWII miniseries: one paratrooper company from D-Day to the end of the war. Ten episodes. You gave Shōgun and Chernobyl 9s, and this is the same caliber of history TV.
items.synopsis: Drawn from interviews with survivors of Easy Company, as well as their journals and letters, Band of Brothers chronicles the experiences of these men from paratrooper training in Georgia through the end of the war. As an elite rifle company parachuting into Normandy early on D-Day morning, participants in the Battle of the Bulge, and witness to the horrors of war, the men of Easy knew extraordinary bravery and extraordinary fear - and became the stuff of legend. Based on Stephen E. Ambrose's acclaimed book of the same name.

items.title: All of Us Are Dead
items.why: A zombie outbreak traps students in a Korean high school. Relentless survival with real stakes.
items.synopsis: A high school becomes ground zero for a zombie virus outbreak. Trapped students must fight their way out — or turn into one of the rabid infected.

items.title: Lost
items.why: The original mystery-box show: a plane crash, an island, and a mythology that keeps escalating. The final season divides people, but the ride is huge.
items.synopsis: Stripped of everything, the survivors of a horrific plane crash  must work together to stay alive. But the island holds many secrets.

items.title: The Sandman
items.why: Dream-king fantasy from Neil Gaiman, made of distinct arcs. Includes a standout horror diner episode.
items.synopsis: After years of imprisonment, Morpheus — the King of Dreams — embarks on a journey across worlds to find what was stolen from him and restore his power.

items.title: Creature Commandos
items.why: Gunn's adult-animated monster squad. Irreverent superhero action in 7 episodes.
items.synopsis: A group of nonhuman criminals comprised of an anthropomorphic weasel, a robot, the bride of Frankenstein, a radioactive skeleton, and their human leader are tasked with stopping an evil sorceress.

items.title: Orphan Black
items.why: Clone conspiracy thriller with a lead playing a dozen characters. Fast-moving and high-concept, and it ends well.
items.synopsis: A streetwise hustler is pulled into a compelling conspiracy after witnessing the suicide of a girl who looks just like her.

items.title: Barry
items.why: Hitman dark comedy about a competent killer who wants out (Ozark, Dexter).
items.synopsis: A hit man from the Midwest moves to Los Angeles and gets caught up in the city's theatre arts scene.

items.title: Harley Quinn
items.why: Archer-style adult animated action comedy with a strong cast and a fast pace.
items.synopsis: Harley Quinn has finally broken things off once and for all with the Joker. Now, she's trying to make it on her own as the criminal Queenpin of Gotham City, with help from Poison Ivy and a ragtag crew of DC castoffs.

items.title: The Legend of Vox Machina
items.why: Adult animated fantasy: a D&D party with Archer-level crude humor and real stakes, dragons included.
items.synopsis: After saving the realm from evil and destruction at the hands of the most terrifying power couple in Exandria, Vox Machina is faced with saving the world once again-this time, from a sinister group of dragons known as the Chroma Conclave.

items.title: Paradise
items.why: A president is murdered, and a Secret Service agent investigates. The episode 1 twist reframes everything. Thriller pacing.
items.synopsis: The tranquility in a serene, wealthy community inhabited by some of the world's most prominent individuals explodes when a shocking murder occurs and a high stakes investigation unfolds.

items.title: Snowpiercer
items.why: The last humans on a perpetually moving train, with class war and murder mystery. High concept, complete in 4 seasons.
items.synopsis: More than seven years after the world has become a frozen wasteland, the remnants of humanity inhabit a gigantic, perpetually-moving train that circles the globe as class warfare, social injustice and the politics of survival play out.

items.title: Hit-Monkey
items.why: Adult animated Marvel: a monkey assassin and the ghost of a hitman in Tokyo. Archer (11) energy with real violence.
items.synopsis: After a high-profile political assassination goes sideways, an injured hitman hides out amongst a tribe of snow monkeys in the mountains of Japan.

items.title: WandaVision
items.why: A high-concept sitcom mystery that unravels into a superhero reality-bender. 9 tight episodes. Currently streaming on Hulu.
items.synopsis: Wanda Maximoff and Vision—two super-powered beings living idealized suburban lives—begin to suspect that everything is not as it seems.

items.title: The Patient
items.why: A therapist chained in a serial killer's basement. 10 short, tense episodes with a firm ending.
items.synopsis: A psychotherapist finds himself held prisoner by a serial killer who demands he help him curb his homicidal urges.

items.title: Mare of Easttown
items.why: A small-town detective and a murder with many suspects. A 7-episode mystery with a genuinely surprising, earned ending.
items.synopsis: A detective in a small Pennsylvania town investigates a local murder while trying to keep her life from falling apart.

items.title: Justified
items.why: A cowboy US Marshal in Kentucky crime country. Sharp dialogue and great villains, and it sticks the landing.
items.synopsis: A character drama based on the 2001 Elmore Leonard short story "Fire in the Hole." Leonard's tale centers around U.S. Marshal Raylan Givens of Kentucky, a quiet but strong-willed official of the law. The tale covers his high-stakes job, as well as his strained relationships with his ex-wife and father.

items.title: The Gentlemen
items.why: Guy Ritchie crime comedy, the series. An aristocrat inherits an estate with a weed empire under it. Snatch energy.
items.synopsis: When aristocratic Eddie inherits the family estate, he discovers that it's home to a huge weed empire, and its proprietors aren't going anywhere.

items.title: His Dark Materials
items.why: Fantasy across parallel worlds: daemons, armored bears, and a war on the Church. Complete and builds well.
items.synopsis: Lyra is an orphan who lives in a parallel universe in which science, theology and magic are entwined. Her search for a kidnapped friend uncovers a sinister plot involving stolen children and turns into a quest to understand a mysterious phenomenon called Dust. She is later joined on her journey by Will, a boy who possesses a knife that can cut windows between worlds. As she learns the truth about her parents and her prophesied destiny, the two young people are caught up in a war against celestial powers that ranges across many worlds.

items.title: The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power
items.why: Middle-earth's Second Age: Sauron's rise and the forging of the rings. Uneven, but huge for a Fellowship (12) fan, and season 2 is darker and better.
items.synopsis: Beginning in a time of relative peace, we follow an ensemble cast of characters as they confront the re-emergence of evil to Middle-earth. From the darkest depths of the Misty Mountains, to the majestic forests of Lindon, to the breathtaking island kingdom of Númenor, to the furthest reaches of the map, these kingdoms and characters will carve out legacies that live on long after they are gone.

items.title: Russian Doll
items.why: A dark comedy time loop: she dies every night at her 36th birthday party. Tight, 8 episodes.
items.synopsis: Nadia keeps dying and reliving her 36th birthday party. She's trapped in a surreal time loop -- and staring down the barrel of her own mortality.

items.title: Common Side Effects
items.why: Adult Swim dark comedy thriller: a mushroom that cures everything, and the pharma and government agents hunting it.
items.synopsis: Former high school lab partners Marshall and Frances begin to unravel a conspiracy involving big pharma and the federal government to suppress knowledge of a rare mushroom that may hold the key to curing all the world’s diseases.

items.title: Good Omens
items.why: An angel and a demon try to stop the apocalypse. Gaiman and Pratchett dark-comedy fantasy, Futurama-level wit.
items.synopsis: Aziraphale and Crowley, of Heaven and Hell respectively, have grown rather fond of the Earth. So it's terrible news that it's about to end. The armies of Good and Evil are amassing. The Four Horsemen are ready to ride. Everything is going according to the Divine Plan...except that someone seems to have misplaced the Antichrist. Can our heroes find him and stop Armageddon before it's too late?

availability_note: Subscription availability checked on JustWatch US on 2026-10-30

schema.rows[].items[]: title, year, type (movie|show), services[], links{service:web URL}, poster (relative path), why, synopsis, genres[], imdb, tmdb, justwatch
schema.services{}: badge color + Android TV package used for the 'Open in app' intent
schema.anime: Same shape as one rows[] entry: {label, items[]} with identical item fields. Rendered as a third row after rows[].
schema.rows[].items[].tag: optional; 'explore' marks a deliberate pick outside the usual genres (for discovery). Clients may show a badge or ignore it.

items.title: Parasyte -the maxim-
items.why: An alien parasite takes over a teen's hand instead of his brain. Creature horror with real ideas, right in your The Strain (9.5) lane.
items.synopsis: A species of parasitic aliens descends on Earth and quickly infiltrates humanity by entering the brains of vulnerable targets; insatiable beings that gain total control of their host and are capable of transforming themselves to feed on unsuspecting prey. High school student Shinichi Izumi falls victim to one of these parasites, but the creature fails to take over his brain and ends up in his right hand.

items.title: Vinland Saga
items.why: Viking revenge epic. Season 1 is relentless; it's for your Game of Thrones and Frieren side.
items.synopsis: For a thousand years, the Vikings have made quite a name and reputation for themselves as the strongest families with a thirst for violence. Thorfinn, the son of one of the Vikings' greatest warriors, spends his boyhood in a battlefield enhancing his skills in his adventure to redeem his most-desired revenge after his father was murdered.

items.title: Made in Abyss
items.why: Descend a giant pit of strange monsters and relics. Cute art over a genuinely brutal dark fantasy world.
items.synopsis: Located in the center of a remote island, the Abyss is the last unexplored region, a huge and treacherous fathomless hole inhabited by strange creatures where only the bravest adventurers descend in search of ancient relics. In the upper levels of the Abyss, Riko, a girl who dreams of becoming an explorer, stumbles upon a mysterious little boy.

items.title: Golden Kamuy
items.why: A brutal survival-treasure hunt in Hokkaido after the Russo-Japanese War. The violence and dark comedy of Hell's Paradise (9.5).
items.synopsis: In the early 20th century in Hokkaido, Japan, a treasure hunt between various parties takes place for a hidden stash of gold.

items.title: Hellsing Ultimate
items.why: An unstoppable vampire works for the Protestant church against Nazis and the Vatican. Gloriously excessive gothic action, 10 OVAs.
items.synopsis: For over a century, the mysterious Hellsing Organization has been secretly protecting the British Empire from the undead. When Sir Integra Hellsing succeeded as the head of the organization, she also inherited the ultimate weapon against these supernatural enemies: Alucard, a rogue vampire possessing mysterious and frightening powers. Now, Hellsing must deal with a more dangerous threat than vampires.

items.title: Dorohedoro
items.why: A man with a lizard head hunts the sorcerer who cursed him. Dark comedy gore in a grimy world.
items.synopsis: Amnesiac Caiman seeks to undo his lizard head curse by killing the sorcerer responsible, with his friend Nikaido's help. In the Hole, that's a threat.

items.title: Ragna Crimson
items.why: Dragon hunters in a bloody, high-stakes dark fantasy. Brutal action in the Hell's Paradise (9.5) lane.
items.synopsis: Ragna teams up with the enigmatic Crimson to stand against the dragons menacing the world. Although Crimson's motivations are mysterious, his goal and Ragna's perfectly align, and together they'll vanquish the dragons once and for all.

items.title: Monster
items.why: A surgeon saves the wrong boy, then spends years hunting the killer he became. Slow-burn mystery thriller often named one of anime's best.
items.synopsis: Kenzou Tenma, a Japanese brain surgeon in Germany, finds his life in utter turmoil after getting involved with a psychopath that was once a former patient.

items.title: Heavenly Delusion
items.why: Post-apocalyptic mystery with two timelines that slowly converge. Creepy monsters and big reveals.
items.synopsis: In the year 2024, the world has collapsed. Grotesque monsters lurk amongst the ruins of Japan, while remaining people scrape together what they can to survive. Kiruko, an odd-job girl in Nakano, accepts a mysterious woman's dying wish to take a boy named Maru to a place called Heaven. Maru is convinced that there will be a boy there who looks exactly like him.

items.title: Devilman Crybaby
items.why: Brutal, wild 10-episode demon horror from Masaaki Yuasa. Ends hard.
items.synopsis: With demons reawakened and humanity in turmoil, a sensitive demon-boy is led into a brutal, degenerate war against evil by his mysterious friend, Ryo.

items.title: Dororo
items.why: A samurai missing 48 body parts kills demons to win them back. Dark fantasy with monster-of-the-week momentum.
items.synopsis: During the Warring States period, the young thief Dororo encounters Hyakkimaru, a strange, sightless boy who wields fearsome prosthetics in place of his missing limbs. Parts of Hyakkimaru’s body were traded to a group of 12 demons by his father in exchange for power, but thanks to a kindly medicine man, Hyakkimaru survived his horrifying ordeal. Now he roams the land in search of his missing body, and together he and Dororo will fight to survive in an unforgiving, demon-plagued world.

items.title: Blade of the Immortal
items.why: A cursed immortal samurai must kill 1,000 evil men to die. Grimy swordplay and dark violence.
items.synopsis: Manji is a crass, violent samurai with a special ability: he cannot die. Cursed with immortality by the nun Yobikuni as punishment for his ruthless deeds, he has grown weary of his ageless life. The only way to lift the curse is to slay 1,000 evil men. So Manji wanders Japan, shedding the blood of the wicked on his quest to finally die.

items.title: Summer Time Rendering
items.why: Time-loop sci-fi mystery on an island where doppelgangers are killing people. Closest anime to Dark (10), and fully completed.
items.synopsis: Shinpei Ajiro travels home to attend the funeral of a childhood friend, and finds the remote island plagued by a sinister, supernatural force.

items.title: Death Note
items.why: High-concept cat-and-mouse between two geniuses, with strict rules. The first half is all-time great.
items.synopsis: Light Yagami is an ace student with great prospects—and he’s bored out of his mind. But all that changes when he finds the Death Note, a notebook dropped by a rogue Shinigami death god. Any human whose name is written in the notebook dies, and Light has vowed to use the power of the Death Note to rid the world of evil. But will Light succeed in his noble goal, or will the Death Note turn him into the very thing he fights against?

items.title: Code Geass: Lelouch of the Rebellion
items.why: A strategic mastermind with one rule-bound power, plus mecha war and constant reversals. Complete in 2 seasons.
items.synopsis: Japan has been invaded and conquered by the Britannian Empire. Japan is now known as Area 11 and its citizens known as Elevens. The Britannian Empire takes away Japan's autonomous power and imposes its rule through the use of Knightmares. The Empire's rule has never faltered, but cracks have begun to show...

items.title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress
items.why: Steampunk armored trains vs. hordes of undead Kabane, from the studio behind Attack on Titan. Stylish creature action.
items.synopsis: In the midst of an industrial revolution, the people of Hinomoto fight hordes of undead creatures, known as Kabane, using powerful armored trains.

items.title: Sword of the Demon Hunter
items.why: A swordsman fights demons through a century-spanning historical epic. Dark fantasy swordplay.
items.synopsis: Jinta journeys through a century-spanning epic, all while questioning why he wields a sword.

items.title: Gachiakuta
items.why: Thrown into the abyss for a crime he didn't commit, a boy fights trash monsters with a rule-based power. 2025's breakout dark shonen.
items.synopsis: Accused of murder and thrown into the Pit, a young orphan joins a group of monster fighters with special powers to uncover the truth and seek vengeance.

items.title: Dan Da Dan
items.why: Fast sci-fi horror comedy with aliens versus ghosts. Wild, kinetic, and never slow.
items.synopsis: When Momo and Okarun's beliefs clash, they're thrown into a world of ghosts, aliens and awakened powers.

items.title: Mob Psycho 100
items.why: A psychic middle schooler with world-ending power just wants a normal life. Explosive, inventive fights from the One-Punch Man creator, with real heart; a My Hero Academia (9.7) pick.
items.synopsis: Shigeo Kageyama, a.k.a. "Mob," is a boy who has trouble expressing himself, but who happens to be a powerful esper. Mob is determined to live a normal life and keeps his ESP suppressed, but when his emotions surge to a level of 100%, something terrible happens to him! As he's surrounded by false espers, evil spirits, and mysterious organizations, what will Mob think? What choices will he make?

items.title: Steins;Gate
items.why: Time-travel sci-fi thriller with strict rules. Slow first few episodes, then it becomes one of anime's best, Dark-style.
items.synopsis: A group of friends have customized their microwave so that it can send text messages to the past. As they perform different experiments, an organization named SERN who has been doing their own research on time travel tracks them down and now the characters have to find a way to avoid being captured by them.

items.title: The Promised Neverland
items.why: Orphanage kids discover the truth and plan an escape. Season 1 is a near-perfect strategy thriller. Skip season 2.
items.synopsis: Emma, Norman and Ray are the brightest kids at the Grace Field House orphanage. And under the care of the woman they refer to as “Mom,” all the kids have enjoyed a comfortable life. Good food, clean clothes and the perfect environment to learn—what more could an orphan ask for? One day, though, Emma and Norman uncover the dark truth of the outside world they are forbidden from seeing.

items.title: Kaiju No. 8
items.why: A man becomes a kaiju but joins the force that fights them. A clean shonen in the My Hero Academia (9.7) lane.
items.synopsis: A man working a job far removed from his childhood dreams gets wrapped up in an unexpected situation - becoming a monster, he aims once again to fulfill his lifelong dream.

items.title: Paranoia Agent
items.why: Satoshi Kon's surreal mystery: a kid with a golden bat attacks people and no one can describe him. Creepy and strange.
items.synopsis: Musashino, Tokyo. An elementary schooler repeatedly attacks people in the streets. Known only to the public as "Lil Slugger", none of the victims can recall the young boy's face and only three distinct details are left in their memories: golden inline skates, a baseball cap, and the weapon: a bent golden baseball bat. Detectives Ikari and Maniwa set out to track down the perpetrator and put an end to his crimes.

items.title: Another
items.why: A cursed class where students die in Final Destination (8.6)-style accidents. 12-episode mystery horror.
items.synopsis: When Kouichi arrives at his new school, he immediately senses something frightening in the atmosphere of his new class, something that no student wants to talk about and that seems to be related to a mysterious and silent girl.

items.title: High School of the Dead
items.why: A zombie outbreak at a high school. Loud, gory survival action, and heavy on fan service.
items.synopsis: A small group of students at Fujimi High are fighting for their lives after surviving a zombie outbreak. It is up to Takashi to unite the survivors and escape the horrors that surround them. In this new world of the living dead...will they escape?

items.title: Babylon
items.why: A prosecutor uncovers a pharma conspiracy that spirals into a dark political thriller.
items.synopsis: Prosecutor Seizaki Zen investigates illegal acts by a pharmaceutical firm, uncovering a conspiracy surrounding the election for Tokyo's new autonomous western zone.

items.title: Psycho-Pass
items.why: Cyberpunk crime procedural in a Minority Report-style precrime state. Season 1 is the one to watch.
items.synopsis: In the year 2113, people are given brain scans to determine how likely they are to commit a crime. Those who fail are apprehended, or even killed.

items.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
items.why: Stand battles are rule-based puzzles, like Nen fights. Every part is a new arc with a new cast, so there's no filler.
items.synopsis: Follow the intergenerational feud between the Joestar Family and various forces of evil, the most prominent of which is Dio Brando and his followers.

items.title: Helck
items.why: A human hero tries to become the next Demon Lord in a tournament. Fantasy action with dark humor.
items.synopsis: Three months have passed since the Demon Lord was struck down, and the Demon Realm is holding a tournament to select his replacement. The leading contestant is Helck, a human hero who claims to hate his own kind. Some aren't happy with the idea of a human becoming the next Demon Lord—especially Vermilio the Red. She wants nothing more than to protect demonkind and prove Helck to be their enemy, even if she has to rig the competition to do it!

items.title: Tougen Anki
items.why: A boy with awakened Oni blood hunts the Momotaro assassin who killed his father. Fast dark-fantasy action.
items.synopsis: After a Momotaro assassin suddenly kills his adoptive father, Shiki vows to avenge him. But first, he must learn to control his newly awakened Oni blood.

items.title: Ajin: Demi-Human
items.why: Immortals are hunted by humans in an action thriller with creepy ghost-like powers.
items.synopsis: 17 years ago, immortals first appeared on the battlefields of Africa. Later, rare, unknown new immortal lifeforms began appearing among humans, and they became known as "Ajin" (demi-humans). Just before summer vacation, a Japanese high school student is instantly killed in a traffic accident on his way home from school. However, he is revived, and a price is placed on his head. Thus begins a boy's life on the run from all of humankind.

items.title: Puella Magi Madoka Magica
items.why: A magical girl show that turns into tragic dark fantasy within a few episodes. Only 12 episodes.
items.synopsis: She has a loving family and best friends, laughs and cries from time to time... Madoka Kaname, an eighth grader of Mitakihara middle school, is one of those who lives such a life. One day, she had a very magical encounter. She doesn't know if it happened by chance or by fate yet. This is a fateful encounter that can change her destiny. This is a beginning of the new story of the magical witch girls.

items.title: Dusk Beyond the End of the World
items.why: A man wakes centuries later in a post-AI world with an android companion. Quiet sci-fi, newer on HIDIVE.
items.synopsis: When tensions around AI spark civil unrest, Akira is caught in the crossfire when he protects his girlfriend from an assassin. Hundreds of years later, he awakens from cryogenic sleep to an unfamiliar world and bonds with the android Yuugure.

items.title: Yofukashi no Uta
items.why: A sleepless boy meets a vampire girl in the night city. Stylish and laid back, lighter than your usual.
items.synopsis: Ko, a human boy, falls in love with Nanakusa, a vampire girl, and wants to become a vampire too, but Nanakusa invites him to her abandoned building just to taste the sweet blood from her neck.

items.title: Ergo Proxy
items.why: A moody sci-fi mystery in a dome city where monsters called Proxies awaken. Slow, philosophical and weird.
items.synopsis: Thousands of years after Earth’s atmosphere was destroyed, adventure blooms in the strangest of places. The domed city of Romdo is supposed to be perfect, but Re-l Mayer, a young female inspector from the Civilian Intelligence Office, knows better. In this place where humans and robots coexist, she receives a strange message: something is awakening!

items.title: NieR:Automata Ver1.1a
items.why: Androids fight machines on a dead Earth while the truth about the war keeps shifting. Based on the game.
items.synopsis: Animated adaptation of NieR: Automata (2017), where a long-running war on post-apocalyptic Earth between androids and machines soon unveils the truth of the world.

items.title: Trigun
items.why: The original 1998 sci-fi western about the gunman Vash the Stampede. Watch this before Trigun Stampede.
items.synopsis: Trigun takes place in the distant future on a desert planet. Vash the Stampede is a gunfighter with a legend so ruthless he has a $$60,000,000,000 bounty on his head. Entire towns evacuate at the rumor of his arrival. But the real Vash the Stampede, the enigmatic and conflicted lead character, is more heroic, even though he usually acts like a complete idiot.

items.title: Neon Genesis Evangelion
items.why: Teens pilot giant bio-mechs against Angels in the landmark psychological sci-fi series.
items.synopsis: At the turn of the century, the Angels returned to Earth, seeking to wipe out humanity in an apocalyptic fury. Devastated, mankind's last remnants moved underground to wait for the day when the Angels would come back to finish the job. Fifteen years later, that day has come... but this time, humanity is ready to fight back with terrifying bio-mechanical weapons known as the Evangelions. Watch as Shinji, Rei, Asuka and the rest of the mysterious shadow agency Nerv battle to save earth from total annihilation.

items.title: Cowboy Bebop
items.why: Space bounty hunters, jazz, and noir. Most episodes are self-contained, with a famous ending.
items.synopsis: In 2071, roughly fifty years after an accident with a hyperspace gateway made the Earth almost uninhabitable, humanity has colonized most of the rocky planets and moons of the Solar System. Amid a rising crime rate, the Inter Solar System Police (ISSP) set up a legalized contract system, in which registered bounty hunters, also referred to as "Cowboys", chase criminals and bring them in alive in return for a reward.

items.title: Pluto
items.why: Sci-fi murder mystery about who is killing the world's greatest robots. Prestige-level and only 8 episodes.
items.synopsis: When the world's seven most advanced robots and their human allies are murdered one by one, Inspector Gesicht soon discovers that he's also in danger.

items.title: Erased
items.why: A man sent back to his childhood to stop a serial killer. A 12-episode mystery that feels like Dark meets Zodiac.
items.synopsis: Satoru Fujinuma is a struggling manga artist who has the ability to turn back time and prevent deaths. When his mother is killed he turns back time to solve the mystery, but ends up back in elementary school, just before the disappearance of his classmate Kayo.

items.title: Mononoke
items.why: A medicine seller exorcises spirits by uncovering their form, truth and reason. Beautifully strange supernatural horror.
items.synopsis: The Medicine Seller is a deadly and mysterious master of the occult who travels across feudal Japan in search of malevolent spirits called mononoke to slay. When he locates one of these spirits, he cannot simply kill it; he must first learn its Form, its Truth, and its Reason in order to wield the mighty Exorcism Sword and fight against it. He must begin his strange exorcisms with intense psychological analysis and careful investigative work—an extremely dangerous step, as he must first confront and learn about the mononoke before he even has the means to defeat it.

items.title: Dark Gathering
items.why: A spirit medium and a genius girl hunt evil spirits at haunted sites. Supernatural horror.
items.synopsis: The story centers on Keitarou Gentouga, who has the ability to be a spirit medium. In junior high school, he got someone else wrapped up in a spirit possession incident, and he has been a shut-in for more than two years. As he reintroduces himself to society as a private tutor, he meets a genius girl named Yayoi Houzuki. Yayoi is instantly able to tell that Keitarou has skill as a spirit medium, and she invites him to go with her to a haunted location. The two then start their journey capturing evil spirits.

items.title: Kengan Ashura
items.why: Corporations settle disputes with underground death matches. Pure fight-tournament momentum, no filler.
items.synopsis: Middle manager Kazuo finds himself thrust into underground corporate warfare when assigned to handle a powerful fighter. Their path leads to a tournament where businesses battle for supremacy.

items.title: Ninja Kamui
items.why: A former ninja's family is murdered and he goes on a bloody revenge spree. John Wick with ninjas, from Adult Swim.
items.synopsis: Former ninja Joe Higan is ambushed by assassins who seek bloody revenge on him and his family for their betrayal, after escaping his clan and fleeing into rural America.

items.title: Lazarus
items.why: Cowboy Bebop director's sci-fi action thriller: find the man behind a deadly drug in 30 days. 13 episodes.
items.synopsis: In 2052, a Nobel Prize-winning neuroscientist develops a drug called Hapna — a cure-all that has the unexpected side-effect of causing death three years later. In response to this threat, a special force of agents—nicknamed "Lazarus"— is assembled to take on the malevolent Skinner.

items.title: Oshi no Ko
items.why: A doctor is reborn as an idol's son and gets pulled into a dark mystery in the entertainment industry. Gripping first episode.
items.synopsis: A doctor and his recently-deceased patient are reborn as twins to a famous Japanese musical idol and navigate the highs and lows of the Japanese entertainment industry as they grow up together through their lives.

items.title: Zom 100: Bucket List of the Dead
items.why: A burnt-out office worker finds new life in a zombie apocalypse. Funny, gory and upbeat.
items.synopsis: A worker in a foreign finance company is bullied and worked around the clock, before a zombie outbreak finally makes him feel alive.

items.title: The Eminence in Shadow
items.why: A fan of secret masterminds is reborn in a fantasy world and plays one, and it turns out to be real. Action comedy.
items.synopsis: Shadowbrokers are those who go unnoticed, posing as unremarkable people, when in truth, they control everything from behind the scenes. Sid wants to be someone just like that more than anything, and something as insignificant as boring reality isn’t going to get in his way! He trains in secret every single night, preparing for his eventual rise to power—only to be denied his destiny by a run-of-the-mill (yet deadly) traffic accident. But when he wakes up in a another world and suddenly finds himself at the head of an actual secret organization doing battle with evil in the shadows, he’ll finally get a chance to act out all of his delusional fantasies!
